name: piupiu
description: PiuPiu — a child-friendly falling-word English pronunciation game with emoji faces, playful effects, spoken hints, star-beam rewards, eight PixiJS ambience scenes, PHaVE and PHRASE lists, themed packs, K-12 reading lists, BNC/COCA word families, and Chinese, French and English UI.
